agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on June 11, 2025, in Audit Committee Report 12.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Thursday, June 5, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Friday, June 6.

attachments.attachment_title: English Document 1 – OAG Supportive Housing Audit AODA.pdf
French Document 1 – OAG Supportive Housing Audit AODA.pdf
English Document 2 – OAG Supportive Housing Audit - Highlights AODA.pdf
French Document 2 – OAG Supportive Housing Audit - Highlights AODA.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset, Committee carried Motion No. AC 2025-12-01, below, to allow consideration of the report on this item.
Nathalie Gougeon, Auditor General, and Joanne Gorenstein, Deputy Auditor General, presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Committee. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Dr. Tim Aubry (Centre for Research on Educational and Community Services, University of Ottawa) also answered questions from Committee.
City staff also answered questions from Committee. Specifically, Clara Freire, General Manager, Community and Social Services, Kale Brown, Director, Housing, and Deanna Vecchiarelli, Program Manager, Homelessness Programs answered questions.
There were no written submissions on this item.
Roxanne Field (Wateridge Village Community Association) addressed Committee and provided comments on the item.
Following discussions, the Committee considered the report recommendation(s) and Motion No. AC 2025-12-02 as follows:

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Audit Committee receive the audit report and recommend that Council consider and approve the recommendations.

WHEREAS the report on this item was issued separately from the agenda and published on June 5, 2025;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Audit Committee approve the consideration of the report for this item at today’s meeting, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2025-100) to allow for the timely consideration of the report and its recommendations.

WHEREAS the Auditor General's report on Supportive Housing refers directly to the funding required from the federal and provincial governments for the City of Ottawa to operate much needed supportive housing and much needed health and social services dollars to provide wraparound support within community housing for tenant support;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Audit Committee recommend that Council direct the City Clerk to send the Audit Report on Supportive Housing to the following Ministers at both the Federal and Provincial governments:
